scope: Acceptance targets for the authorized PAPER account. These are research objectives, not projected or promised returns, and do not alter runtime financial authority.

evaluation.clock: First full regular market session after candidate source, parameters, prompts, cost model and universe are locked. Register the resulting 20-session calendar before the first open.
evaluation.episode: One verified flat-to-position-to-flat inventory interval, including every partial fill, fee and exit. Orders, canceled attempts and partial exit fills are not episodes.
evaluation.volume: Absolute filled buy plus sell notional. Submitted or canceled notional is excluded.
evaluation.profits: Realized and marked open P&L at executable bid, less spread, execution slippage, regulatory and broker fees, model charges and allocated data charges. Deduct each cost once. Require reconciled flat closes; unresolved positions or fills make results inconclusive.

controls: Current deployed Bayn strategy with its actual single-position, close-of-session lifecycle.
A repeated-entry deterministic momentum policy using the same verified inputs, timing, sizing, risk, execution and position management as the Jev candidate.
The candidate with Jev outputs removed, with selection rules fixed using development data only.

executionEvidence.batchDecisionTime: Maximum completion time of every response actually used to filter or rank candidates, plus state construction, durable persistence and routing delay.
executionEvidence.missingQuotesOrAmbiguousSizes: Retain unresolved outcomes. Never substitute complete fills or remove the selected opportunity.
executionEvidence.liquidity: Use quote evidence and explicitly verified size units, with partial fills, IOC expiration and risk-reducing exit retries.
executionEvidence.paperLimitations: Alpaca paper fills do not establish executable size, impact or latency slippage. PAPER profit alone cannot establish live-money profitability.

changeControl: Preserve this version and all failures. Any material policy or protocol revision gets a new version and a fresh untouched evaluation window. Do not lower these success thresholds to fit observed results.
delivery: One active Jev strategy after reviewed merge and automatic Kargo/GitOps migration. No active legacy strategy fallback. Preserve immutable history and risk-reducing management without Jev.
